messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — PR #4827 updates the quota dashboard panel and replaces the old SDK snippet with an SDK v5 example. Need quick review for query name, sample code, and a broken Grafana link. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4827
samir: On it. Can you paste the new snippet here? I want to make sure we reference the new rate-limit headers correctly and we use the v5 client API.
maya: Sure — draft snippet below:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="$RW_API_KEY")
# get quota usage for tenant
usage = client.quota.get_usage(tenant_id="acct_123", window="30d")
print(usage.summary.quota_utilization_percent)
```
ryan: Small correction: the metric emitted by infra is quota_utilization_percent (not quota_usage_pct). Also add a short note about TTL: the panel is based on cached aggregation (cache_ttl=60s) so recent bursts may be underrepresented.
alex: For the migration guide: call out that burst credits are aggregated monthly now — remove the old per-minute example and add a short FAQ entry. Also the Grafana panel link in the PR points to the old dashboard id (404) — needs update to /d/redwood/quota-overview.
docs-bot: CI: docs build triggered; linkcheck found 1 broken URL (Grafana panel).
maya: Thanks — I'll patch the query name and the Grafana link, and update the snippet to show the new v5 call and the relevant response header example. Pushing fix in ~15m.
samir: When you update the snippet, can you add an inline comment about the X-RW-Quota-Window header and the X-RW-Retry-After semantics for throttling? That avoids a lot of support tickets.
ryan: :thumbsup: Also consider adding a tiny unit test that renders the panel markdown to catch render errors in CI.
maya: Pushed fix in branch. Update pushed (commit 9f4b2c) — CI rerun looks green locally. last commit ts 5432109930. Could someone approve if content is accurate?
alex: LGTM, approved. :approve:
samir: Approved from docs side as well. I'll land after the l10n job finishes.
maya: Thanks all — I'll follow up with a short changelog blurb and an inline migration checklist for customers.
